_about: Registry of this style's components (SYSTEM.md): what each one is, its kind and the regexes (sig) that find it in a built index.html. scripts/components.py plan / check / add / record read and write it: history lists your reels in order, projects maps a reel id to its project folder, and each element's reels say where it was used. Empty history = nothing used yet.

elements.desc: lower-band caption card: one ink slab per line, 2-3 chunks slam (1.3 -> 1, 0.13 s, back 1.6) on their word onsets
one keyword per caption on a honey block wiping left to right in 0.12 s, the word turns ink
channel bug top left: honey block + dark chip, 48 px caps, from the sting to the end
source tag under the bug on every document / data shot: SOURCE block + dark label, slides in 0.2 s
ledger sheet #151512, rules every 54 px, red double margin, slides in from the right with honey streaks, push 1.0 -> 1.03
frame-4 hook: the first line stacked on 4 lines, the last word in a 1.7x honey block
honey ruled page over the bottom band (y >= 1140), the title slammed word by word (one word may sit in an ink block), a chip under it; wipes off into the bug
a book cover the speaker names on a dark desk, author and title highlighted on the spoken words, the title re-set in a tilted honey block
lit grid stacked for 9:16: three apps with drawn icons (mail, chat, feed), honey border + red notification dot on each word
ruled list of three basics: numerals 1-3 slam, equal honey bars grow on each word, the previous bar turns ivory
verdict on the speaker's face (wide) at 100-105 px, the last words in the block, soft deep-boom

ideas_not_built_yet: line / bar chart with true sourced numbers
proportion by darkness on a drawn card
